title: Junior QA Analyst
description: Shuttlerock, a dynamic company transforming ad-creative workflows for some of the largest companies in the world, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior QA Analyst to join our team. This entry-level role is an exceptional opportunity for individuals passionate about technology and the tech industry, even without prior experience. While no formal QA background is required, a genuine interest in the tech landscape is essential. You'll be a vital part of a collaborative team, and therefore strong, confident communication skills are paramount.

In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products. You will be responsible for executing test cases, identifying and documenting bugs, and collaborating with our development team to deliver high-quality solutions. Sufficient training will be provided.

You will be joining a global community filled with exceptional, driven, and talented individuals. While our main office is located in the picturesque Nelson, on New Zealand's South Island, we have team members working across the globe.
Key Responsibilities:
Create, maintain and execute detailed test plans and test cases based on project requirements and specifications.
Identify, record, and track software defects using defect tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, Notion).
Perform manual testing of software applications, including functional, regression, and integration testing.
Evaluate UI/UX design to ensure a user-friendly experience.
Conduct thorough regression testing to ensure no new issues are introduced.
Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand system requirements and resolve defects.
Monitor reported issues, assist end users with troubleshooting, and work cross-functionally to resolve problems swiftly.
Contribute to the improvement of testing processes and methodologies.
Assist senior QA team members with complex test cases and testing strategies.
Maintain clear and detailed documentation of test results and bug reports.
Required Skills and Experience:
This entry-level role is an exceptional opportunity. While no formal QA background is required, following communication skills are paramount.
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Problem-solving mindset and a proactive approach.
Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
A "can-do" attitude, with a methodical and patient approach.
Work Location and Schedule:
Office: Nelson, New Zealand
Remote: New Zealand
Standard business hours, with potential for flexible working arrangements.
Working Environment and Culture:

Shuttlerock fosters a collaborative and supportive work environment. We value innovation, creativity, and a commitment to excellence. You will be part of a team that is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions and making a positive impact.
Career Growth:

We are committed to supporting your professional development. This role provides opportunities to advance to senior QA positions, specialise in areas like automation testing, or explore related roles within the technology sector.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
Shuttlerock is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

title: Support Engineer
description: About Us

Admin By Request is a dynamic international software company making significant strides in the global market. Our mission is to deliver cutting-edge security solutions that drive success for our clients. As we expand our operations further into Oceania, we are looking for a dedicated and resourceful Technical Support Engineer to assist our customers and sales from our new office in Auckland, NZ. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the success of our Oceania operations and to be part of a growing international team.
Role Overview

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will play an important part in helping our customers configure and use our products – as well as assist with debugging and troubleshooting. You will also help our sales team with technical onboarding, ensuring that our customers get the best possible experience with our software.

This role demands highly motivated individuals who can operate under freedom with responsibility. You will have the opportunity to help shape the processes and culture alongside the other members of the team.
You’ll be co-located with our marketing, documentation and sales teams in New Zealand, and have the opportunity to help shape the processes and culture alongside other members of the team.
Key Responsibilities
Help customers with onboarding, configuration and troubleshooting of our applications.
Act as a Subject Matter Expert for our products, with deep technical knowledge of the applications.
Document and confirm suspected software defects and product requests. Provide detailed test cases and results to the Development team for resolution.
Act as the Support Readiness facilitator including arranging appropriate training, documentation, and other support preparedness activities.
Review top call drivers and recommend changes to product, training, and support offerings based on the input given by customers and other interested parties.
Technical documentation resource and reviewer of Knowledge Base articles and documentation.
Requirements
Technical background with the ability to grasp complex software solutions.
Great communicative and interpersonal skills. You’ll be interacting with both sales and customers, so it’s important that you’re comfortable in such situations.
An analytical approach to problem solving and the desire to learn new technical skills as the need presents itself.
Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and make informed decisions.
Work self-sufficiently, requiring little direction.

You don’t need to have 15 years of experience as a system administrator, but one of the primary tasks will be helping our customers’ IT admins troubleshoot, so a deeper understanding and experience with various IT aspects is required.
We offer our software on Windows, Mac and Linux – so advanced experience with one or more of these operating systems is a plus.
We Offer
A competitive salary and benefits package.
The opportunity to be part of an international company's growth and expansion in Oceania.
Opportunity to train with our support team in the headquarters in Denmark (Europe).
The opportunity to work and learn from likeminded and highly skilled team members.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where you can make a significant impact.
Professional development opportunities to enhance your skills and career path.
How to Apply

If you are a driven individual with a passion for excellence in technical support, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining why you are the ideal candidate for this role.

title: Network/Systems Administrator
description: The Company

Brand Developers is an entrepreneurial omni channel marketing company with a proprietary sales system that gives us deeper reach and greater operating flexibility than a bricks and mortar retailer. Using a combination of direct and indirect marketing across our direct response TV (DRTV), digital, live events, retail and international divisions, we are able to reach a broad range of customers.  This organization is passionate about technology and for almost 20 years have been committed to leveraging our business processes though effective use of technology.  If you are passionate about technology, an agile workplace and want to help in their vision, this is the role for you!
The role

Brand Developers is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Network/Systems Administrator to join our IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of our network. This role requires a strong understanding of both networking and systems administration principles, with a focus on ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of our IT / Networking systems.
Key responsibilities include:
Networking:
Design, implement, and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
Configure and troubleshoot networking protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and routing protocols.
Implement and maintain network security measures, including firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
Manage cloud networking services, specifically within Microsoft Azure.
Monitor network performance and troubleshoot network issues.
Manage, maintain, and renew SSL certificates.
Systems Administration:
Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, and Hyper-V.
Perform server hardware and software maintenance, including operating system installation and configuration.
Manage virtualization technologies.
Implement and maintain backup and recovery procedures.
Monitor system performance and troubleshoot system issues.
Administer Microsoft Azure cloud services.
Provide technical support to end users.
Maintain accurate and up to date documentation.
Manage and maintain security systems.
About you
Qualifications and Skills:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Relevant professional certifications (CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), vendor-specific certifications related to firewalls or cloud networking).
Proven experience in:
Network infrastructure design, implementation, and troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing protocols, firewalls, VPNs, cloud networking - Azure).
Windows Server administration (Active Directory, Group Policy, Hyper-V).
Virtualization technologies and backup/recovery procedures.
Azure administration. In-depth knowledge of network hardware, security principles, and practices.
Proficiency in scripting and automation (PowerShell or similar).
Proven ability to:
Diagnose and resolve complex network and system issues.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
Work collaboratively within a team and independently.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
This is an on-premises role currently located in central Takapuna but will likely move to Rosebank Road Avondale in the future.
Only applicants with the legal right to work in New Zealand should apply for this role.

title: System Administrator
description:

Change and impact notification

Demonstrated experience in system administration of either Windows or Linux-based systems OR network administration

Demonstrated experience with databases, networks (LAN, WAN) and patch management

Why work for us

Medical Insurance and Vision Care packages

Enhanced employer contributions to your Kiwisaver

Generous Leave benefits, including additional paid days off and enhanced sick and parental leave

Childcare allowance for your preschoolers

Onsite free gym (Wellington only)

Opportunities for personal and professional growth and career pathways across the intelligence community

Flexible working options, and great work-life balance

Working within our unique environment means we have to ensure you're eligible for employment.

Have been a New Zealand Citizen for at least 10 years


OR

title: Analyst Applications Support
description: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SERVICES
INFORMATION SYSTEMS GROUP

The University of Otago is New Zealand's oldest University and is growing its digital capabilities to position for the future. To this end the organisation has modernised its Information Systems department with new roles and a mission to deliver future focused digital systems that will enable the organisation for the years ahead.
Come and join a great team that helps the future happen.
•    Great people and a collaborative IT culture.
•    Awesome employee benefits, working from home and flexible work options.
•    Competitive salary and 5 weeks annual leave.
The Role/Te Mahi

In this role you will be the front-facing point of contact for customers and end users of information systems and the escalation point for others in the support team for large and complex systems knowledge and expertise.

You will take the lead when complex problems are reported, both anticipate and be responsive to customers, business processes, operational needs, and issues; prioritise activities and manage client expectations.

In this role, you will have an opportunity to proactively build and maintain strong collegial and collaborative relationships with internal customers particularly information system owners and users, AskOtago, IT Support Services and IT Services Division colleagues.
With a focus on continuous improvement, you will:
•    Analyse user requests and translate routine requirements into cost-effective design and configuration recommendations.
•    Identify opportunities for automation or repetitive tasks and seek to optimise value adding support work.
•    Provide Level II and above support, troubleshooting and problem resolution to users.
•    Manage lifecycle changes to information systems and provide input to the enterprise architecture function for the effective management of information systems.
Skills and Experience/Kā Pūkeka me Kā Wheako
To be successful in this role you will have:
•    Tertiary qualification in a relevant discipline or recognised qualification(s) appropriate to the role.

•    Considerable demonstrated experience in the provision of customer focused information systems services, in a medium sized or complex organisation supporting enterprise-wide information systems; system administration; system integration; or general IT service delivery and support.
•    ITIL Certification.
•    Experience in administering, maintaining, and documenting enterprise and/or distributed systems.
•    Experience with systems implementation processes and practices.
We pride ourselves on working as a team, so great team and interpersonal skills are essential (as well as a good sense of humour!).
About Our Team/Mō Te Tīma

The Applications Support group within ITS is a team of skilled IT professionals focused on supporting and maintaining a wide range of applications and systems that power our administrative, operational, teaching and research functions used by the wider University of Otago community.

At the University of Otago, you would be joining the team responsible for empowering our future of New Zealand thinkers every day. You will be making learning easier for 21,000 students, setting 5,000+ staff up for success, and enabling the ground-breaking research which kick-starts innovations to benefit generations to come.

If you’ve been looking for a change or that next career step that allows you to use your skills to make a real impact, this is truly it. You’ll join a passionate team, just as driven as you are to continuously improve our organisation and the environment for our students and staff. Plus, you will have constant backing if you’re looking to innovate, grow your skills and use them to help us create new and better ways of doing things.

This is a full-time (37.5 hours per week), permanent position, located in Dunedin.

We offer a competitive salary, 5 weeks’ annual leave, a 6.75% superannuation scheme, and the ability to achieve real work/life balance. More information regarding employee benefits can be found here: Employee Benefits
You must have the right to live and work in New Zealand to apply for this position.
The appointment range for this position is $82,181 to $89,057, Top of Range $94,211 per annum.
